$comment: The organization's issue types, as created in Organization settings, Planning, Issue types (REST: /orgs/monte3l/issue-types, which needs admin:org to write). A record of what the policy in tracking.md expects, not applied by any script: bin/apply-repo-baseline.sh works on one repository, and issue types belong to the organization. The issue forms in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE name three of them (Bug, Feature, Task) in `type:`, so a rename here needs the forms to change in the same commit. GitHub allows 25.

types.name: Bug
types.description: Something is broken, or behaves differently from what the docs say.

types.name: Feature
types.description: A new capability or a committed change to what the project does.

types.name: Task
types.description: Other actionable work that is neither a defect nor a new capability.

types.name: Gap
types.description: Drift or inconsistency between the docs, the code and the standard.

types.name: Debt
types.description: A known shortcut to pay down, or a feature scheduled for removal.

types.name: Verify
types.description: A claim someone intends to check before it can be relied on.
